node.title: Re: Matching backslash in regexp negative lookbehind
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Unfortunately I don't have enough time right now to wrap my head around the regex - I just wanted to point out a few resources that might help:

  • [mod://Regexp::Common::delimited] - handles escaped quotes too
  • [doc://Text::Balanced]
  • For parsing [doc://Data::Dumper], various efforts to parse Perl like [mod://PPI], and of course [mod://PPR] (a single regex!)
  • The classic [id://995856] (although probably a little too much for this case ;-) )
